nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes Workforce Planning with the WFM Platform for Aviation Operations

overview.overview: See how Pentafox enables airlines to plan, allocate, and monitor manpower efficiently, improving staffing visibility, operational efficiency, and compliance.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
In aviation operations, effective workforce planning is critical to ensure smooth flight handling, ground operations, and on-time performance. Traditionally, manpower planning was managed through spreadsheets, manual rosters, and fragmented systems, making it difficult to align staffing with dynamic flight schedules and operational requirements. This often resulted in manpower shortages, overstaffing, last-minute changes, and operational inefficiencies.
Workforce Management (WFM) was developed as a centralized digital platform to plan, allocate, and monitor manpower based on flight schedules, operational rules, and available workforce. By replacing manual planning with automated rostering and real-time workforce visibility, WFM ensures the right staff are assigned to the right tasks at the right time—improving operational efficiency, compliance, and reliability.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription: FastKYC is an API-first identity verification platform designed to simplify and automate customer onboarding across regulated industries through secure, real-time verification workflows.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription: This solution powers a scalable, in-house Loan Origination System (LOS) by acting as a centralized integration layer that manages and orchestrates third-party financial service APIs throughout the loan lifecycle.

nodes.name: Sutherland ALFA Lite – AI-Powered Chatbot

overview.overview: An AI-driven business analytics chatbot platform that makes enterprise data accessible and actionable through natural language, voice commands, and document-based insights.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
PFA–ALFA is an AI-driven roleplay training platform built for the BPO and customer support 
industry.
Earlier, trainees relied on manual classroom training and human roleplay to learn customer 
handling.
This led to low confidence, inconsistent responses, and unnecessary call escalations.
PFA–ALFA provides a safe, scalable, and intelligent environment to practice real customer 
interactions before going live.

nodes.name: ALFA SNAP – Intelligent Document Analytics

overview.overview:
SNAP (Salary Negotiation Automation Platform) is an AI-driven web-based solution that 
automates salary document analysis and negotiation workflows.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
SNAP (Salary Negotiation Automation Platform) is an AI-driven web-based solution that 
automates salary document analysis and negotiation workflows.
Earlier, HR and operations teams manually reviewed payslips, offer letters, experience letters, 
and hike letters.
They extracted and grouped salary components and performed complex calculations using 
company-specific rules.
This led to high effort, errors, and slow turnaround times.
SNAP transforms this into an intelligent, automated process delivering accurate salary insights 
and faster decisions.

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes Lead Management with KVB-LMS

overview.overview: See how Pentafox centralized lead management to enable faster follow-ups and better customer conversion.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
KVB-LMS (Lead Management System) is a web and tablet-based application developed for the banking sector to streamline the management of customer (leads). In banks, a lead refers to a potential customer who has shown interest in purchasing a loan.

Before the implementation of KVB-LMS, banking staff relied on manual processes and fragmented systems to record, track, and follow up on Customers (leads). This approach often resulted in inconsistent data, delayed follow-ups, difficulty in tracking lead status, and reduced conversion efficiency.

To address these challenges, KVB-LMS was designed as a centralized digital platform that allows bank employees to capture, update, and manage lead information efficiently through both web and tablet applications. The system enables staff to maintain complete customer details, monitor lead progress, and ensure timely follow-ups, thereby improving operational efficiency and customer experience.

The project focuses on providing a secure, user-friendly, and reliable solution that supports banking staff in managing high volumes of leads while maintaining data accuracy and compliance with banking standards.

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes Cybercrime Complaint Processing with NCRP Digital Web Application

overview.overview: See how Pentafox digitized cybercrime complaint processing to enable faster, secure, and compliant financial fraud response.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
NCRP Digital Web Application is a secure web-based platform developed for KVB to support the National Cybercrime Reporting Portal (NCRP) initiative and streamline cybercrime financial fraud complaint handling.
Earlier, complaints were processed through manual and fragmented workflows, causing delays, limited visibility, and higher risk of errors.
The solution was built as a centralized, API-driven platform integrated with I4C and Core Banking Systems (CBS).
It automates complaint validation, enables real-time banking actions, and provides end-to-end case tracking.
The system delivers faster response times, improved transparency, and strong regulatory compliance.

nodes.name: Pentafox Centralizes DICGC Premium Filing with a Digital Platform

overview.overview: See how Pentafox digitized DICGC premium computation and filings to ensure accurate, compliant, and audit-ready reporting.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
The DICGC Premium Computation & Filing Platform is a centralized, web-based application built to digitize the end-to-end DICGC premium filing process for banks.
 Earlier, filings were managed through spreadsheets, emails, and manual branch-driven workflows, leading to high effort and audit risk.
The platform introduces a secure, role-based digital command centre.
 It automates premium computation, submission, review, approval, and audit workflows.
 The solution ensures accuracy, traceability, and compliant execution of twice-yearly DICGC filings.

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes Alcohol Testing Compliance with the Breathalyzer Platform for Aviation Operations

overview.overview: See how Pentafox digitized alcohol testing for aviation and ground teams to improve accuracy, compliance, visibility, and operational efficiency.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
In aviation and ground operations, workplace safety is paramount. Alcohol testing is a critical safeguard, but traditional paper-based recordkeeping often led to errors, inefficiencies, and compliance risks.
Breathalyzer was developed as a digital platform to manage and track alcohol testing for aviation and ground staff. By replacing error-prone paper records with a centralized, auditable system, it ensures workplace safety, transparency, and compliance. The solution streamlines workflows, automates notifications, and provides managers with clear access to test histories—reducing manual effort and strengthening accountability

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes Ground Operations Asset Management with the AMS Platform for Airline Operations

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox digitized procurement processes
to improve control and transparency.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Ground operations assets are critical for safe and efficient airline operations.
Previously, asset tracking, inspections, and maintenance were managed manually using registers, Excel sheets, and emails.
This led to poor visibility across stations, missed service schedules, and limited audit traceability.
AMS was introduced as a centralized digital platform to address these challenges.
It enables teams to manage asset inventory, inspections, servicing schedules, and maintenance history from a single source—improving control, compliance, and operational efficiency.

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes End-to-End Procurement Workflows with the Procure360 Platform

overview.overview: Explore how Pentafox helped organizations replace email- and Excel-driven procurement processes with a centralized, rule-based platform—streamlining purchase requests and approvals, enabling transparent vendor quotation collection and comparison, maintaining complete audit trails, and providing real-time visibility across procurement teams to improve control, compliance, and operational efficiency.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Earlier, procurement activities such as purchase requests, approvals, and purchase order creation were managed through emails, Excel sheets, and manual follow-ups. Approval status was often unclear, vendor quotations were handled offline, and maintaining an audit trail for compliance was difficult and time-consuming.

Procure360 was developed to digitize the complete procurement lifecycle. The platform manages everything from raising Purchase Requests (PRs) to approving Purchase Orders (POs) and collecting vendor quotations—bringing all procurement activities into a single, centralized, and controlled system.

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes Passenger Boarding and Reconciliation with the PRS Platform

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox enabled post-booking meal selection
through automated WhatsApp workflows.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Passenger boarding and reconciliation are critical for on-time departures and safety compliance. Previously, these processes were handled manually by agents, leading to delays, duplicate checks, incorrect passenger status updates, and operational confusion in busy airports.
PRS was developed to digitize and streamline boarding and reconciliation.
It is a web and mobile platform that enables agents to scan boarding passes and update passenger status in real time, while admin and operations teams monitor progress through a centralized system.

nodes.name: Pentafox Automates Competitive Fare Analysis and Pricing Decisions with the Pricing Portal Platform

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox unified flight operations data
to improve coordination and regulatory compliance.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Airline pricing teams traditionally relied on Excel spreadsheets to collect competitor fares, compare them with internal pricing, and manually calculate recommended fares. This process involved maintaining multiple files, applying complex formulas, and continuous manual updates. As a result, pricing decisions were slow, error-prone, and heavily dependent on manpower.
The Pricing Portal was introduced to fully digitize and automate the pricing workflow. The platform centralizes competitor pricing, internal fare data, and business inputs into a single system and generates intelligent price recommendations—enabling faster, more accurate, and data-driven pricing decisions.

nodes.name: Pentafox Digitizes In-Flight Sales and Operations with the IFS Platform

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox digitized boarding and reconciliation
to reduce delays and eliminate errors.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Airlines traditionally relied on manual, paper-based processes to record in-flight sales and inventory details. Cabin crew documented transactions during flights, which often resulted in data entry errors, missing stock, and payment mismatches—especially when flights had multiple legs and limited internet connectivity.
The In-Flight Service (IFS) platform was developed to digitize in-flight sales and operational tracking. It is a web and mobile solution that enables cabin crew to record sales and inventory using mobile devices, while office and management teams monitor sales, stock levels, and payments through a centralized system. All data is securely stored and synchronized to ensure accuracy and transparency.

nodes.name: Pentafox Streamlines Crew Cab Booking and Journey Management with the Enroute Platform

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox digitized airline fare analysis
to enable faster, more accurate pricing decisions.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Crew transportation is a critical part of airline operations and requires precise coordination between operations teams, drivers, and crew members.
Previously, cab bookings and journey updates were managed through phone calls, WhatsApp messages, and Excel sheets.
Tracking journeys, assigning vehicles and drivers, and handling last-minute changes involved heavy manual effort and frequent follow-ups, often leading to confusion and delays.
Enroute was introduced to centralize and automate crew cab booking and journey management.
By digitizing bookings, notifications, and tracking, the platform ensures smooth coordination, clear communication, and improved operational reliability.

nodes.name: Pentafox Enhances Passenger Communication by Integrating Booking Contact Data with DCS Through the Guest Bridge Platform

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox streamlined post-booking meal selection
to improve convenience and ancillary revenue.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Departure Control Systems (DCS) play a critical role in managing flight operations and passenger movement. However, the core DCS does not store or expose passenger contact details, such as mobile numbers, directly from booking data. This limitation created communication gaps and operational challenges, especially when teams needed to contact passengers close to departure time.
The Guest Bridge Application was introduced as a supporting layer alongside the existing DCS. It retrieves passenger contact and booking information from booking systems using PNR data and makes it available within operational workflows—without modifying core DCS functionality or increasing manual effort.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Meal Booking System — Meal Booking via WhatsApp Bot

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox improved airline operational communication
without modifying core DCS systems.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Many airline passengers forget to book meals at the time of ticket purchase. Once the booking is completed, adding a meal often requires visiting a website or contacting customer support, which can be inconvenient and time-consuming.
The WhatsApp Meal Booking System was introduced to simplify post-booking meal selection. The system allows airlines to send automated WhatsApp messages to passengers before departure, enabling them to book meals directly through a familiar and widely used platform. Passengers can either interact with a WhatsApp bot for guided booking or use a simple web link, making the process fast, intuitive, and accessible.

nodes.name: Pentafox Centralizes Flight Operations Management with the RedCap Platform

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox digitized asset tracking for ground operations
to improve safety, compliance, and efficiency.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Airline flight operations involve continuous coordination between ground staff, operations teams, and management. Earlier, critical information such as flight logs, delays, ground handling activities, and operational reports were maintained across multiple tools and manual records. This fragmentation resulted in slow communication, inconsistent data, and increased chances of errors.
RedCap was developed to centralize all flight operation data into a single digital platform. By consolidating operational records, automating notifications, and standardizing reporting, the system improves visibility, accuracy, and real-time communication across airline teams.

nodes.name: Pentafox Centralizes Airline Flight Operations Monitoring with the CoreOps Platform

overview.overview:
See how Pentafox unified airline operational data
to deliver real-time visibility and improved operational control.

detailedDescription.detailedDescription:
Airline operations rely on multiple data sources such as flight schedules, crew rosters, pilot attendance, dispatch documents, and operational reports. Earlier, this information was scattered across different systems and manual processes, making real-time monitoring difficult and increasing coordination effort for operations teams.
CoreOps was developed to centralize these operational elements into a single web-based platform. By bringing together schedules, crew readiness, dispatch status, and pilot attendance in one system, CoreOps provides teams with a clear, real-time view of daily airline operations and improves overall operational control.
